title: AHB5 Exclusive Success and Failure
description: For the optional AHB5 Exclusive_Transfers property, compare monitor establishment, successful and failed conditional writes, unsupported-location behavior, and reset-cleared state. Exclusive access never reserves the bus.

phases.name: Read HMASTER=3
phases.description: HEXCL=1 and HTRANS=NONSEQ. On completion, HREADY=1 with HEXOKAY=1 reports that the supported target established monitor state for HMASTER=3, address/location, HSIZE, HPROT, HBURST, and HNONSEC when present.

phases.name: Bus remains free
phases.description: The initiating master performs local work; no global ownership lock is held.

phases.name: Matching write
phases.description: HMASTER=3 issues a matching exclusive write with the same required address-phase attributes to a monitored location that has remained unchanged.

phases.name: HEXOKAY=1
phases.description: With HRESP=OKAY and HREADY=1, the monitor reports exclusive success and the write updates memory. HEXOKAY cannot be asserted with HRESP=ERROR.

phases.name: Read HMASTER=7
phases.description: A supported exclusive read completes with HEXOKAY=1 and establishes independent state for HMASTER=7.

phases.name: Bus remains free
phases.description: Other traffic is allowed because this is not a locked sequence.

phases.name: Matching write after interference
phases.description: HMASTER=7 attempts a matching conditional write after another master changed the monitored location.

phases.name: HRESP=OKAY · HEXOKAY=0
phases.description: The monitor reports exclusive failure and memory is not updated. Conditional failure can return HRESP=OKAY with HEXOKAY=0 and is not a lock failure.

phases.name: Writes monitored location
phases.description: A different master writes the location tracked for HMASTER=7, invalidating that monitor condition. The monitor's tracked-location/granule policy must cover all writes that can interfere; it is not safely modeled as an unrelated exact-address shortcut.

phases.name: Exclusive read
phases.description: The master attempts an exclusive read to a target that does not support exclusive sequences.

phases.name: HEXOKAY=0
phases.description: The read completion deasserts HEXOKAY, so no monitor state is established and software must not rely on a following exclusive write succeeding.

phases.name: Reset clears state
phases.description: HRESETn LOW clears implementation monitor state; a pre-reset read cannot authorize a post-reset write.

phases.name: Read establishes
phases.description: A supported exclusive read with HEXOKAY=1 establishes state for its HMASTER identity and matching attributes.

phases.name: Interference invalidates
phases.description: An observed interfering write invalidates the affected tracked location before the conditional write.
